worldcombat.skill.cottonguard.summary: Wrap up to greatly raise Defense; each melee contact crushes one layer and gently pushes the striker back a step, with Defense retracting by the layers left. The last layer or expiry ends it. The thick coat also cuts movement speed by 25%.
worldcombat.skill.cottonguard.use.0: Wrap up before eating a burst
worldcombat.skill.cottonguard.use.1: Bounce a step of escape space out of a close-range swarm
worldcombat.skill.cottonguard.use.2: Hold through sustained pressure behind the coat window
worldcombat.skill.cottonguard.descriptio: Raises Defence by up to %1$s stages with %2$s layers of fluff, limited by the stage cap; each melee contact takes back this Defence by the layers left.
The coat lasts about %1$s. Expiry, removal or fluffing off every layer ends only its own Defence boost and clears its heavy-coat slow.
One effective melee contact crushes at most one layer every 0.4 s and pushes the striker horizontally up to %1$s; ranged, friendly and environmental damage take no layer and push no one.
worldcombat.skill.cottonguard.cocoon.on: Thick coat: Defense +3 levels and more, longer-lasting fluff, but 25% slower movement while it holds, with a longer wind-up and cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.cottonguard.cocoon.off: Light coat: Defense +2 levels, no slow, a shorter wind-up and cooldown; it shields less but does not hinder movement.
worldcombat.skill.cottonguard.timing: Self move, range %1$s blocks; after %2$s s of wind-up it spends %4$s PP, recovers for %3$s s and starts a %5$s s cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.cottonguard.growth.0: At level %1$s the coat extends to %2$s and the cooldown shortens to %3$s s.
worldcombat.skill.cottonguard.growth.1: At level %1$s the coat extends further to %2$s and the cooldown shortens to %3$s s.
worldcombat.skill.cottonguard.preference: Thick: Defense +3 levels and more, longer-lasting fluff, but 25% slower movement, a longer wind-up and a longer cooldown; Light: Defense +2 levels, no slow and quicker.
